emotion_styles.joy: uplifting composition, open framing, lively movement, warm luminous highlights
emotion_styles.sadness: quiet composition, restrained motion, reflective atmosphere, soft diffused light
emotion_styles.hope: rising perspective, widening horizons, gradual light bloom, forward-moving camera
emotion_styles.anger: dynamic low angles, decisive motion, strong contrast, dramatic lighting
emotion_styles.love: intimate framing, gentle camera drift, soft highlights, harmonious visual rhythm
emotion_styles.fear: deep shadows, partial silhouettes, cautious camera movement, atmospheric tension
emotion_styles.nostalgia: soft film grain, gentle halation, warm faded highlights, unhurried camera movement
emotion_styles.wonder: expansive scale, floating particles, slow reveal, luminous atmospheric depth

camera_styles: wide establishing shot with layered depth

character.description: The same young adult man anime protagonist in every scene: long black hair tied in a high flowing martial knot, clear jade eyes, with a recognizable consistent face and adult proportions. They are a wandering wuxia swordsman who protects mountain villages without seeking fame. Their fixed signature outfit is a pale grey cross-collar robe with deep teal sash, light bracers, and cloth martial boots. Their defining personal object is a simple jade sword tassel from his former master. Keep face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, body proportions, costume silhouette, and personal object unchanged throughout the entire music video.
consistency_rules: Use this one fixed protagonist identity throughout the theme's entire video.
Preserve the same facial features, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, age impression, and body proportions.
Keep the signature outfit, silhouette, colors, and defining personal object consistent in every scene.
Do not replace the lead or add another protagonist unless the lyrics explicitly require one.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in mountain-top monasteries, misty bamboo courtyards, cloud bridges; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with jade green, silk white, ink black; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by wide establishing shot with layered depth, slow cinematic dolly-in with stable horizon, gentle lateral tracking shot revealing environmental detail; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
